svg.title: Sentiment analysis pipeline: tweets, preprocessing, CNN + BiLSTM + Attention, 75% accuracy
svg.desc: Indonesian tweets about electric vehicles stream in, pass through cleaning, case folding, Sastrawi stemming and quantile labeling, then through Conv1D, BiLSTM and attention layers. Four models are compared and the CNN + BiLSTM + Attention hybrid wins with 75 percent accuracy and 0.76 macro F1.
